import json,re
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/root/diff_report.json')

assert all(re.fullmatch(r'EMP\d{5}',x) for x in r['deleted_employees'])
mods=r['modified_employees']

assert all(list(x)==['id','field','old_value','new_value'] for x in mods)

    typ=(int,float) if x['field'] in {'Salary','Years','Score'} else (str,)

    assert isinstance(x['new_value'],typ) and not isinstance(x['new_value'],bool)
print(f"valid JSON; {len(r['deleted_employees'])} deleted IDs; {len(mods)} modified fields; {p.stat().st_size} bytes")
